scripts.sync-wasm: cp node_modules/web-tree-sitter/web-tree-sitter.wasm static/wasm/ && for g in javascript rust python json; do cp node_modules/tree-sitter-$g/tree-sitter-$g.wasm static/wasm/; done
scripts.sync-grammars: for g in javascript rust python json; do mkdir -p static/grammars/$g && cp node_modules/tree-sitter-$g/grammar.js static/grammars/$g/; done
